summary: Social-buzz ranker. Takes a Binance Square snapshot (most-searched / rapid-riser / hashtags) as JSON input, dedupes candidates, and validates each with kline-driven trend/momentum/volume signals to produce a verdict + direction bias.
core_logic: Accept a social snapshot via inputs.square_snapshot {en: [...], zh: [...]} per section.
Dedupe candidates by symbol and rank by recurrence + EN/CN overlap + section overlap.
For each candidate, fetch klines via adapter (or fixture bars_by_symbol) and compute EMA/RSI/volume_zscore.
Aggregate social score (heat) + technical score (trend/momentum/volume) into 0-100 composite.
Tag verdict (STRONG_CANDIDATE -> AVOID) and direction (LONG / SHORT / WATCH).
recommended_next_step: Promote STRONG_CANDIDATE rows into structured-trade-plan for entry/exit zones.
